title: All systems go for Batanes special polls to replace deceased lawmaker
summary: ITBAYAT, Batanes – The Commission on Elections (Comelec) is all geared up for the November 28 special elections for the lone congressional seat representing Batanes, the country’s northernmost…

blocks.text: ITBAYAT, Batanes – The Commission on Elections (Comelec) is all geared up for the November 28 special elections for the lone congressional seat representing Batanes, the country’s northernmost province.
Batanes Election Officer Lee Lawrence Baldomar on Wednesday (November 18) briefed members of the Electoral Board who will man the 12 clustered precincts in four voting centers in this island town.
Election paraphernalia will be prepositioned at the Municipal Treasurer’s Office by Friday (November 27), in preparation for the polls the following day.
Batanes has 13,655 registered voters as of the 2025 elections. At present, Itbayat town has a voting population of 1,998.

Four aspirants are vying to serve the unexpired term of Batanes congressman Ciriaco B. Gato Jr., who passed away on September 21. They are Luis Abad, Marilou H. Cayco, Edward Ike de Sagon, and John B. Gato, a brother of the late congressman. /jpv
